#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:** This love
, which is
 active
 and manifest in the human
 mind
 as
 it exists
 in the natural
 state
, performs
 five spiritual
 operations.

**¶2:**
 The first operation
 it
 performs is this: it
 cons
umes and destro
ys what
 is merely natural good
 and
 every
 element
 of the self
hood that is submitted
 to it.

**¶3
:** The second: it separates from
 that
 natural good four distinct
 ess
ences —
 love
 itself
 and
 wisdom
, what
 is spiritu
ally dead and without
 life
, and
 what is obscure falsity rising
 from the consumed
 natural mind
.

**¶4:** The
 third: it gives the
 perception
 of good and the delight of truth
 to whatever of
 the
 natural
 mind is
 transformed
 by it
. It also im
parts the warmth of charity and spiritual
 joy to whoever
 draws
 near to it in
 affection.

**¶5
:** The fourth operation it
 performs:
 all fac
ulties of the
 understanding
,
 working
 through
 love
, fashion
 the containing
 forms of the mind — the interior
 vessels
 of
 doctrine
 and affection —
 by
 means
 of it
.

**¶6:** The
 fifth: it radiates wisdom out
ward, and by
 that wisdom all persons come to perceive
 what is real
.


---


*
Note
:
* The progression
 is
 striking
 —
 love
 first
 destroys,
 then separ
ates, then n
ourishes, then forms
, and
 finally illumin
ates. This
 mirrors precisely
 the order
 of regener
ation:
 the
 consumption
 of the
 prop
rium,
 the discrimination
 of interior
 states
, the reception
 of spiritual
 perception
, the formation
 of new
 interior
 structures
, and at
 last the opening
 of sight
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: This fire, which burns and is apparent today in the world, it does five works.
The first work that it does is this: It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.
The second: It separates four aspects of the wood, which are these: fire and light, ash and smoke.
The third: It gives a taste and an {aroma} to whatever will be cooked on it. It also gives heat and cheer to whoever will be close to it.
The fourth work that [it] does: All craftsmen shall work the utensils that they will fabricate in it.
The fifth: It shall display light, and the people see by [it].
